# BH Air Duct Cleaning Metro Detroit

> Licensed & insured air duct cleaning company serving all of Metro Detroit, Michigan. Whole-home air duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, furnace & AC coil cleaning, duct sanitizing, camera inspections, HVAC restoration, and commercial HVAC cleaning.

## About

BH Air Duct Cleaning Metro Detroit is a licensed and insured air duct cleaning company headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. We dispatch trained technicians with negative-pressure source-removal equipment across every city in Metro Detroit for same-day duct and dryer vent service and scheduled cleanings. Every job ends with before-and-after photos of the customer's own ductwork.

- Business name: BH Air Duct Cleaning Metro Detroit
- License: Licensed & Insured
- Phone: (313) 236-4558
- Email: info@bhairductcleaningmetrodetroit.com
- Hours: Sun–Thu 24 hours · Fri until 6 PM · Sat closed
- Service area: All of Metro Detroit, MI (Detroit, Warren, Sterling Heights, Troy, Dearborn, Livonia, Royal Oak, Southfield, Farmington Hills, Pontiac, Canton, Westland, and every surrounding city in Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb counties).

## Services

- Residential air duct cleaning (negative-pressure source removal, NADCA-standard process)
- Commercial air duct cleaning (offices, retail, medical, restaurants, industrial)
- Dryer vent cleaning (full-run rotary brush cleaning, airflow verification, fire prevention)
- HVAC system restoration (smoke, puff-back, and flood decontamination)
- Furnace & AC coil cleaning (blower wheel, evaporator coil, burner compartment)
- Duct sanitizing & deodorizing (EPA-registered antimicrobial fogging after cleaning)
- Camera duct inspection & air quality checks
- Post-construction duct cleaning (drywall dust and renovation debris removal)
- Duct & dryer vent maintenance plans
- Same-day & emergency duct service
